title: Choose the visual world for /jobs
question: The roll assigned Night Game Agate. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. /jobs stays a scan-and-act workspace: apply, mark applied, hide, save. Same capabilities can move.

options.label: Night Game Agate
options.lineage: late-night stadium box scores and sports-wire agate
options.thesis: The live internship market is a box score you mark, not a dashboard you browse.
options.viewport: No hero. A full-bleed scoreboard of CLOCK / TEAM / PLAY rows with a full-height APPLY · SCORE · K · FLAG rail, period tabs as innings across the top.
options.risk: Reads as sports novelty if the LED metaphor decorates a normal list instead of becoming the density of a real box score.

raised.raise: Course Snap: every new or filtered row ticks as one whole-line step, never a fade.
Inning Air: filter groups sit as scored blocks with deep gaps, not one endless tape.
End-Label Grid: every listing is a locked CLOCK / TEAM / PLAY line, no wrapping cards.

options.label: Departure Board
options.lineage: airport FIDS and Solari split-flap boards
options.thesis: Open roles are departing flights: scan the board, catch the ones you can still make.
options.viewport: A dark board of destination rows: company as city, role as flight, recency as STD, Apply as GATE. Filters hang as city/status headers above the flaps.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on: live data dressed as a transit board.

options.label: Printer’s Plate Sheet
options.lineage: design-annual plate section on uncoated stock
options.thesis: The catalog as one continuous press sheet: internships as plates, actions as filled ink rects.
options.viewport: One sheet. 72px sticky mono token bar. Listings in a 4-up then full-width plate row, Apply a 0-radius black rect, crosshairs at sheet corners.
options.case: Holds product clarity: a hairline sheet is a denser scan surface than a card feed. Loses audience identification: intern hunters do not live in printer’s annuals.
options.risk: Reads as a portfolio when the registration furniture outranks the roles.

options.label: One-Role Snap Feed
options.thesis: One role owns the viewport; Apply / Mark / Hide / Save stack as a right rail; the next role is one snap away.
options.viewport: Company and title low-left over the posting field, four rail glyphs on the right, next listing already loaded below the snap.
options.case: Holds audience identification: students already hunt this way. Loses product clarity: one-at-a-time hides the live market they came to scan.
options.risk: Turns a market into a slot machine and buries filters offstage.

options.label: Cutting Bench
options.thesis: Roles are frames on a perforated rail: grease-cross Applied, punched-corner Can’t fit, hung-pin Saved, tape-band Apply.
options.viewport: A perforated select rail of filter frames at a fixed height; the listing strip scrubs under it; discarded roles hang on pins in an open bin below.
options.case: Holds product clarity: state is a mark, not a hue, which maps apply / hide / save exactly. Loses audience identification: SWE intern hunters are not editors at a bench.
options.risk: Orange drench and film grain become costume if the rail is not the actual navigation.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.case: Loses both: one window cannot show a market, and intern hunters do not wait at a depot bench.
options.kept: Course Snap: whole-row steps, never glides.

options.label: Sneaker Box Wall
options.case: Loses both: pulling boxes is slower than scanning rows, and the wall is fashion storage, not a job market.
options.kept: End-Label Grid: a locked three-field line on every listing.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.case: Loses both: weather blocks cannot carry listing facts or scan-and-act, and identification is zero.
options.kept: Inning Air: sectional density with deep gaps between groups.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A Handshake / Simplify / LinkedIn intern board executed at full craft: sidebar, filters, card rows, primary Apply.
canonCard.viewport: Left nav, top search, filter chips, featured card, then a list of internships with Apply on the right.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
